# Documentation

> A lightweight, modular SCSS mini-framework: design tokens, utility classes and layout mixins.

## Utilities

- [Border Width](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/border-width.md): Utilities for controlling the width of an element's borders.
- [Display](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/display.md): Utilities for controlling the display type of an element.
- [Flex Direction](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/flex-direction.md): Utilities for controlling the direction of flex items.
- [Font Size](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/font-size.md): Utilities for controlling the font size of an element.
- [Padding](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/padding.md): Utilities for controlling an element's padding.
- [Text Color](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/text-color.md): Utilities for controlling the text color of an element.
- [Width & Height](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/sizing.md): Utilities for setting the width and height of an element.
- [Background Color](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/background-color.md): Utilities for controlling the background color of an element.
- [Border Radius](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/border-radius.md): Utilities for controlling the border radius of an element.
- [Flex Wrap](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/flex-wrap.md): Utilities for controlling whether flex items wrap.
- [Font Weight](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/font-weight.md): Utilities for controlling the font weight of an element.
- [Margin](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/margin.md): Utilities for controlling an element's margin.
- [Position](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/position.md): Utilities for controlling how an element is positioned.
- [Align Items](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/align-items.md): Utilities for controlling how flex items are aligned on the cross axis.
- [Border Color](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/border-color.md): Utilities for controlling the border color of an element.
- [Box Shadow](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/box-shadow.md): Utilities for controlling the box shadow of an element.
- [Gap](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/gap.md): Utilities for controlling the gutters between grid and flex items.
- [Overflow](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/overflow.md): Utilities for controlling how content overflows an element.
- [Text Align](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/text-align.md): Utilities for controlling the alignment of text.
- [Justify Content](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/justify-content.md): Utilities for controlling how flex items are distributed on the main axis.
- [Opacity](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/opacity.md): Utilities for controlling the opacity of an element.
- [White Space](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/whitespace.md): Utilities for controlling text wrapping and white space handling.
- [Z-Index](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/z-index.md): Utilities for controlling the stack order of an element.
- [Transitions](https://senseikatana.github.io/utilities/transitions.md): Utilities for controlling transition duration and timing functions.
